ind. In six ways.

-न्यासः the six ways of touching the body with mystical texts. 
-मुखः ‘six-faced’, N. of Kārtikeya; द्रोढा जनोर्जनितषोढामुखः समिति वोढा स हाटकगिरेः [[
p. p. [सह्-क्त इडभाबः] Borne, suffered, endured, put up with &c.; see सह्.

a. (ढ्री f.) [सह्-तृच्] 
__1 Enduring, bearing, patient.
